newsitem.title: USA: Kmart creates new merchandising positions.
newsitem.headline: Kmart creates new merchandising positions.

text.p: TROY, Mich., July 21 - Kmart Corp said Monday it promoted three executives to newly created positions in an effort to bolster its home fashions, pantry and logistics operations.

Kmart said Steve Ryman has been made brand director of the Martha Stewart Everyday Line, in addition to his previous title of Divisional Vice President of home fashions. He will continue to oversee home fashions while coordinating the Martha Stewart Everyday brand throughout all divisions.

Michael Meguiar has been promoted from director to the newly created position of Divisional Vice President, Pantry Operations. Kmart said he also will continue to supervise the field structure for high-frequency stores.
Both will report directly to Andy Giancamilli, Senior Vice President and General Merchandise Manager, Home and Consumables.

Kmart also said Matt Hilzinger has been promoted to Divisional Vice President, Logistics Finance and Planning, from director, special projects. In the newly created position, he will be responsible for providing financial support to logistics and will report to Jim Mixon, Senior Vice President, Logistics/DC Operations.
